source: EPA TRI -- PFAS-specific reporting (facility x chemical x year)
texas_record_count: 152 reporting-form records at 15 distinct TX facilities
pfas_specific: YES -- tri_chem_id restricted to the 196 chemicals flagged pfas_ind=1 in tri_chem_info
measured_release_or_pathway: Reported release quantity (lb), where available -- see tri_release_qty; many small releases are range-coded (not an exact pound figure), documented not estimated away
duplicate_facilities_across_datasets: Not cross-matched in this pass (would need FRS registry_id reconciliation across TRI/NPDES/NPL; registry_id IS present in all 3 EF_* files and could support this in a follow-up)
major_missingness: Many Texas TRI facilities report chemicals OTHER than PFAS and never appear here (correctly -- absence means 'did not report a PFAS chemical', not missing data)
usability: RETAIN -- the only true 'reported PFAS release' layer available

source: EPA TRI -- all facility locations (context / linkage backbone)
national_record_count: see EF_TRI.csv (EPA national TRI facility registry, live count varies slightly by pull date)
duplicate_facilities_across_datasets: Not cross-matched in this pass (would need FRS registry_id reconciliation across TRI/NPDES/NPL; registry_id IS present in all 3 EF_* files and could support this in a follow-up)

category: C: site classification (not PFAS-specific without manual screening)
national_record_count: see EF_NPL.csv (EPA national Superfund NPL, live count varies slightly by pull date)
years: current snapshot (site status, not a reporting year)
pfas_specific: NO (NPL does not carry a queryable PFAS flag; would need per-site Record-of-Decision screening, not done here)
measured_release_or_pathway: Site classification (contamination presence, not PFAS-specific or a concentration)
duplicate_facilities_across_datasets: Not cross-matched in this pass (would need FRS registry_id reconciliation across TRI/NPDES/NPL; registry_id IS present in all 3 EF_* files and could support this in a follow-up)
usability: RETAIN AS CONTEXT -- cannot be treated as PFAS-specific without manual Record-of-Decision screening (not done here); used as a generic contamination-site proximity indicator only
